spec: §10: "A run owns the registers and memory it touches exclusively while not CLOSED."; "no register it touched has been prepared, freed, sliced or used by another run since; else E_NOT_REVERSIBLE"
derivation: A second run cannot concurrently use an owned register. Once ownership releases, a subsequent operation touching that register invalidates reversal eligibility of the old completed run.
